title: Slovakian Paprika Pudding
description: A hearty Slovakian dish featuring paprika-spiced pudding, served in a papillote for a moist and flavorful dessert.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine crumbled black pudding, chopped bell pepper, ground paprika, cottage cheese, sugar, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Mix well until all ingredients are fully incorporated.
Cut papillote sheets into 4 equal pieces.
Divide the pudding mixture evenly among the papillote sheets.
Fold the papillote sheets over the pudding, making sure to seal the edges tightly.
Place the papillote packets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pudding is set and the papillote is crispy.
Serve warm, garnished with additional paprika if desired.
